messages:
maya: Quick check — signal-bridge intake: who owns the model variants + blockers for the catalog launch tomorrow? Need owners for licensing / perf / deploy so I can fill the dependency matrix.

catalog-bot: Automated checks for submitted models [signal-bridge-small, signal-bridge-large, bridge-lite] — licensing: bridge-lite -> flagged (vendor subcomponent). Perf baseline: signal-bridge-small p95=120ms on ded-3; signal-bridge-large simulation ready. See internal CI: /eng-ml/cat-ci-123

alex: I'm the infra owner for bridge-lite. Will finish the CR for kernel selection + quantization knobs today. @liam can you confirm GPU window for canary?

jordan: Perf note: bridge-large needs KV cache tuning + q4 path. Simulation shows ~18% token throughput drop with q4, but latency stable. Will run a full staging perf with real traces this afternoon.

liam: infra status: we have capacity in dedicated pools for small/large. Canary needs 4x A100s for 24h window — I can approve if we get a business case and timing. Marked in dependency matrix.

olivia: Curation gap: missing evaluation prompt sets for safety/hallucination/regression tests for all 3 models. @maya can you confirm which prompt_shards to use? we need them to unblock gating.

legal-sue: Licensing check: signal-bridge-small -> Apache-2.0 (clear), signal-bridge-large -> MIT (clear), bridge-lite -> contains vendor proprietary submodule; vendor CLA required. I'll DM vendor and request CLA; marking bridge-lite as blocked until signed.

pm-ryan: Milestone summary: canary start target = 2026-06-10, catalog soft-launch = 2026-06-17. If we have blockers by EOD today we need to triage. Please update the dependency sheet: https://redwood.internal/docs/model-dep-matrix

maya: Thanks — action items I have: (1) @alex finish CR and post link, (2) @jordan run staging perf with q4 path, (3) @olivia upload eval prompt shards, (4) @legal-sue follow up with vendor for CLA. I'll update owners in the sheet and ping SRE for canary window request. :thumbsup:

alex: Noted. CR -> https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/412 (will request review from @jordan and @liam)

catalog-bot: Added reaction :white_check_mark: and updated dependency status: bridge-lite -> blocked_legal.

maya: If anyone can't hit their item, flag here by noon PST so we can move the milestone.
